findings.fact: Default reset pulses RTS true 100ms then false 100ms before Enter. A positive connect_attempts=N permits N+1 physical attempts; the last response is discarded. The current backup parameter 3 therefore permits up to 4 RTS attempts.

Set reset catch, request SYSRESETREQ, Enter, explicitly halt, clear catch, load RAM stub at 0x2005A000, set RTC BKP0R and PA21 GPIO, write PC/SP and run. This source path has no call into the existing Flash boot. Explicit halt after reset does not establish that reset vector catch actually stopped the core before Flash boot.
no_reset still downloads a stub; no_reset_no_sync skips stub setup. These flags do not expose a standalone ROM observation CLI.
52 uses little-endian UART debug framing and Enter/Exit/MEMRead/MEMWrite primitives.
Response framing consumes channel/trailing byte without complete validation and uses a dynamically sized payload; it is not the bounded parser/operation allowlist required by this proposed adapter.
soft_reset dispatches a RAM stub command; common/ram_command.rs maps it to burn_reset. It is not the same operation as the initial RTS pulse or an independently verified cold power reset.

sdk_source_findings.fact: HCPU ROM base 0, size 64KiB, ROM bootloader starts at 0; maskROM reset handler address not obtained from SDK application symbols.
LCPU reset/halt has explicit CPUWAIT and reset handling; HCPU halt is not proof of LCPU inactivity.
PMU reboot explicitly handles LCPU, peripheral LDO2 and NOR addressing state; it cannot be equated to HCPU SYSRESETREQ.

proposed_rehearsal.shared_workflow: Console/Journal plus continuous PortLease and existing application snapshot binding, with a dedicated UART debug adapter
proposed_rehearsal.strong_acceptance: Clear stale debug/reset evidence before single internal reset; observe new reset and vector catch, debug-enabled S_HALT, PC matching the locally read ROM reset vector and consistent VTOR/vectors before any post-reset explicit halt; repeat at >=2500ms; separately prove application recovery.
write_allowlist_design: DHCSR: bounded enable/halt and owned exit values
AIRCR: one SYSRESETREQ intent, no retransmit when response is lost
DCRSR: PC/SP read selectors only, no core-register write bit
proposed_rehearsal.failure_policy: Preserve raw stream, partial observations, exact control/write intents and uncertain recovery. Stop new experiment actions; execute only an explicitly authorized, owned exit branch. Closing a serial handle is not proof the CPU resumed.
proposed_rehearsal.firmware_restore_design: Future separately authorized write window only: verify immutable original boot64KiB and B4KiB against both full backups; prove all Flash users controlled and erase bounds known; restore/read back boot first then B, start application only after both match. No restoration command or write entry point added here.
